name: messaging-send-no-target-error-envelope
description: v1 messages:send with no recipient: HTTP 400, google.rpc envelope with status INVALID_ARGUMENT, details carrying BOTH google.rpc.BadRequest (fieldViolations naming the field) and google.firebase.fcm.v1.FcmError (errorCode). Detail ORDER differs across error cases and is not a contract. Cited by messaging-admin#4, messaging-admin#39 (surface climbing under CDD; cited, not yet replayed).

error.message: Recipient of the message is not set.

fieldViolations.description: Recipient of the message is not set.
